edits:
name: Firebase Hosting
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: nurture-production-hosting
  cancel-in-progress: false

  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    env:
      VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY }}
      VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN }}
      VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: nurture-12398
      VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET }}
      VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID }}
      VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID }}
      VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID }}
      # Deliberately closed until docs/product/release-1-finisher.md acceptance gates pass.
      VITE_RELEASE1_BACKEND_READY: 'false'
      VITE_ENABLE_DEMO: 'false'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:experience
      - run: npx tsc -p tsconfig.analytics.json && node scripts/verify-analytics-contract.mjs
      - run: npm install --prefix functions --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix functions test
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:browser
      - name: Record exact Hosting build provenance
        run: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/release.json', JSON.stringify({commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,release:'1-integration',backendActivated:false})+'\n')"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: verified-hosting-build
          path: dist
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: hosting-predeploy-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/release-1
          if-no-files-found: ignore

    needs: verify
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: verified-hosting-build
          path: dist
      - name: Deploy verified build to existing Firebase Hosting site only
          repoToken: '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}'
          firebaseServiceAccount: '${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NURTURE_12398 }}'

  verify-live:
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        site:
          - { name: firebase, url: 'https://nurture-12398.web.app' }
          - { name: custom-domain, url: 'https://nurture.accelanalysis.com' }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Verify deployed commit and backend gate
        env:
          SITE_URL: ${{ matrix.site.url }}
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 4 "$SITE_URL/release.json" -o /tmp/release.json
          node -e "const r=require('/tmp/release.json');if(r.commit!==process.env.GITHUB_SHA||r.backendActivated!==false)throw Error('Unexpected deployed release');console.log(r)"
      - name: Browser smoke test live Hosting
        env:
          R1_SMOKE_BASE_URL: ${{ matrix.site.url }}
        run: npm run test:browser
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: live-browser-${{ matrix.site.name }}
          path: test-results/release-1
          if-no-files-found: ignore
